240-1251-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1429-4981-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

6797-7084-7893.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4871-6797-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4871-6797-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Phantom Train four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1061-6568-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Y'shtola Rhul.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-1558-3257-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-1558-3257-3875-4231.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1409-5418-5921.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve both Exhibition Magician triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3375-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

141-2511-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2511-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

1978-3053-3789.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-3789.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

1402-2218-4763-4885.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2466-5051-5078-6766.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

934-1238-2351-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

4050-5189-5439-6753.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4050-5189-5439-6753.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

791-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 24 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 3.
791-4567.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

500-2081-3277.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Izzet Chronarch and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Izzet Chronarch tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
969-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

856-2292-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2538-3676-4336-5187.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Guardian Project triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Guardian Project trigger, causing you to return Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-2292-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1636-2292-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-280-943.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Golgari Rot Farm.
Repeat.
74-280-943.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Golgari Rot Farm instead.

1750-2793-3698-5131-5261.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, causing target player to mill three cards.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
When Ugin's Nexus enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

331-791-3693-5934.notablePrerequisites:
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
331-791-3693-5934.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

204-4182-5851.manaNeeded: {16} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters and/or other creatures you control without summoning sickness
204-4182-5851.notablePrerequisites: Sorcerer Class is at least level 2.
204-4182-5851.description:
Activate any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat step 1 until you control no untapped creatures without summoning sickness, or until you have {5}{U} available, whichever comes first.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse, causing you to draw a card, and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3705-5231-5465.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3259-5332.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken creature with haste.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard that has haste.
Breath of Fury attached to the creature on the battlefield that has haste.
Carmen's power is greater than or equal to the mana value of both creature cards that have haste.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Carmen does not have summoning sickness.
3259-5332.description:
Declare Carmen and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Carmen's second ability triggers, returning a creature card with haste from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with haste, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Carmen's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1037-1636-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Multani's Harmony attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1037-1636-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

142-1379-2210-3175.notablePrerequisites: At least three loyalty counters on Saheeli Rai.
142-1379-2210-3175.description:
Activate Saheeli Rai's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of Sun Titan with haste.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, return Mirrormade from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Saheeli Rai.
Put the oldest Saheeli Rai in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Mirrormade's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of Sun Titan with haste.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, return Saheeli Rai from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put the oldest Saheeli Rai in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

549-1558-1692-4075.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Master of Waves.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
549-1558-1692-4075.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Master of Waves with haste.
The Master of Waves token triggers, creating a number of 1/0 Elemental creature tokens equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2523-4112-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sharuum, adding {C}{C}.
Sharuum dies, triggering Ratadrabik, creating a nonlegendary copy of Sharuum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
The Sharuum token enters the battlefield, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning any artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

933-2556-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
